lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with the central 4 lines more closely grouped than those at the anterior and posterior margins.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line segment is truncated, terminating in the upper third of the torso mass. Subsequent lines show varying degrees of fading before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast white spots are located on the upper posterior flank, positioned superiorly to the white femoral band.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A high-contrast white diagonal band forms a semi-continuous geometric line across the upper hind limb/thigh region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, ascending vertically from the frontal bone with a posterior-lateral spiral before curving medially at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 2.8 times the horizontal width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the orbital regions and two white facial spots on the cheek; prominent elongated hair fringe (mane) along the dorsal ridge and ventral neck area.
